audience: recruiting teams that run jobs and candidate pipelines in Workable

useCases.title: See who is in each pipeline stage
useCases.text: List the jobs, then list the stages of one job. List its candidates to see who is in each stage.

useCases.title: Review scheduled interviews
useCases.text: List scheduled calls, interviews and meetings with their start and end times, the candidate and the job.

useCases.title: Read a candidate's full history
useCases.text: Read one candidate's profile, job, stage and source. Then read the activity stream of stage moves, comments and ratings.

useCases.title: Post a comment as a team member
useCases.text: List the team members, then post a comment on a candidate's timeline as one of them. The hiring team can see it.

useCases.title: Move a candidate to another stage
useCases.text: List the pipeline stages, then move a candidate to one of them as a team member. Moves to a hired stage are refused.
